subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, installPolicy, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The requested implementation is feasible but crosses third-party-code execution, config, gateway lifecycle, and supply-chain boundaries that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define default-off policy, provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or channel rules, rollback, audit logs, and failure handling.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Leave `openclaw skills update` and `openclaw plugins update` as the supported paths and document cron or external scheduling for operators who accept the risk.

options.title: Split prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, provenance, and lifecycle safety as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define default-off policy, provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or channel rules, rollback, audit logs, and failure handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across the current package auto-updater, native ClawHub install flow, and plugin update command boundary.
